Sort Key: (CASE p.exposure_band WHEN 'low'::text THEN 0 WHEN 'emerging'::text THEN 1 WHEN 'unknown'::text THEN 2 ELSE 3 END)

discovery.sql: SELECT p.repo_key FROM feed.projects p LEFT JOIN feed.user_project_state ups ON ups.github_id=$1 AND ups.repo_key=p.repo_key WHERE p.publishable=true  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM feed.project_submission_evidence e WHERE e.repo_key=p.repo_key AND e.analysis_id=p.analysis_id)  AND COALESCE(ups.not_interested,false)=false ORDER BY CASE p.exposure_band WHEN 'low' THEN 0 WHEN 'emerging' THEN 1 WHEN 'unknown' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,p.product_score DESC,p.repo_key LIMIT 20

high_user_impression.sql: SELECT MAX(occurred_at) FROM feed.events WHERE github_id=$1 AND repo_key='capacity-owner-00000/synthetic-project-00000' AND event_type='impression'

latest.sql: SELECT p.repo_key FROM feed.projects p LEFT JOIN feed.user_project_state ups ON ups.github_id=$1 AND ups.repo_key=p.repo_key WHERE p.publishable=true  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM feed.project_submission_evidence e WHERE e.repo_key=p.repo_key AND e.analysis_id=p.analysis_id)  AND COALESCE(ups.not_interested,false)=false ORDER BY p.analyzed_at DESC,p.repo_key LIMIT 40

quality.sql: SELECT p.repo_key FROM feed.projects p LEFT JOIN feed.user_project_state ups ON ups.github_id=$1 AND ups.repo_key=p.repo_key WHERE p.publishable=true  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM feed.project_submission_evidence e WHERE e.repo_key=p.repo_key AND e.analysis_id=p.analysis_id)  AND COALESCE(ups.not_interested,false)=false ORDER BY p.product_score DESC,p.confidence DESC,p.repo_key LIMIT 20

Sort Key: (CASE user_tag_preferences.source WHEN 'explicit'::text THEN 3 WHEN 'behavior'::text THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) DESC

((sum(((((sampled.value)::double precision * sampled.strength) * sampled.weight) * sampled.confidence)) / NULLIF(sum(abs(((((sampled.value)::double precision * sampled.strength) * sampled.weight) * sampled.confidence))), '0'::double precision))) DESC

tag.sql: WITH prefs AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT ON(tag_id) tag_id,value,strength FROM feed.user_tag_preferences WHERE github_id=$1 ORDER BY tag_id,CASE source WHEN 'explicit' THEN 3 WHEN 'behavior' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END DESC), sampled AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT pref.tag_id,pref.value,pref.strength,pt.repo_key,pt.weight,pt.confidence FROM prefs pref CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT repo_key,weight,confidence FROM feed.project_tags pt WHERE pt.tag_id=pref.tag_id ORDER BY (pt.weight*pt.confidence) DESC,repo_key LIMIT 160) pt) SELECT sampled.repo_key,SUM(sampled.value*sampled.strength*sampled.weight*sampled.confidence)/NULLIF(SUM(ABS(sampled.value*sampled.strength*sampled.weight*sampled.confidence)),0) affinity FROM sampled CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT 1 FROM feed.projects p WHERE p.repo_key=sampled.repo_key AND p.publishable=true  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM feed.project_submission_evidence e WHERE e.repo_key=p.repo_key AND e.analysis_id=p.analysis_id)  OFFSET 0) p WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM feed.user_project_state ups WHERE ups.github_id=$1 AND ups.repo_key=sampled.repo_key AND ups.not_interested=true) GROUP BY sampled.repo_key ORDER BY affinity DESC,sampled.repo_key LIMIT 80
